source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master body is TBD and boilerplate clears evidence, though the title defines a bounded standard read suitable for conditional guidance.

review_improvement: Provides auditable timestamp decoding while preserving the TBD source and separating observation from correction.
independent_technical_reasoning: Repository time must be interpreted with its own epoch/offset and capture latency; a mismatch is evidence only. Bracketing the query with a trusted reference avoids treating network delay or local timezone rendering as device clock failure.
